hypothesis: A causal cap of three combined firing dates in any five observed market sessions preserves >=70% TP5/H10 touches and positive same-day selection excess while producing 2-3 combined firing dates per five sessions.
prior_evidence: Unrestricted old cohort3.57/5sessions failed cadence. Cap3 is taken directly from user requirement, not selected by return testing. No historical capped-cohort outcomes were inspected. This is a cadence/contract variant, not evidence of a new alpha mechanism.
capture: Immutable first successful capture of producer report, original picks and eligible same-day ticker universe after signal close and before 09:00 Asia/Seoul on the next calendar day. Late/missing captures are coverage failures, never historical fills. Holidays make this deadline conservative.
evaluation: First120 observed sessions starting20261007; adjudicate only after allH10 mature. Longer fixed window chosen before first observation to allow the less frequent KOSDAQ leg to reach unchangedn30/20dates under the cap. Existing separate60-session study unchanged. No interim promotion or optional stopping.

statistics.controls: Frozen same-date market/liquidity universe excluding original selected tickers; identical executable next-open TP5/H10 and costs. Random ticker relabel and circular date-shift diagnostics.

kill_criteria: At the fixed mature window, any target miss rejects this candidate for promotion; report every miss. Before then report PENDING. Do not combine prior replay with this cohort.
publication: Shadow only. No routing/sizing. No historical backfill to manufacture cohort. Passing this report cannot publish; requires matching current-epoch gate, family-aware review and all producer/consumer wiring.
targets_scope: Joint candidate: sample, touch, net/excess and ticker-placebo targets apply to each market and combined. Frequency target is combined firing dates. No post-hoc market subset promotion. Circular date-shift is a timing diagnostic, not a stock-alpha gate.

cadence.count: one date even if both markets fire
cadence.missing_history: fail capture; never treat missing prior snapshot as abstention

multiple_testing.method: Bonferroni ticker-placebo p times2. Original standalone study keeps its report; any eventual promotion review must apply this family correction to either candidate. 95% block intervals remain descriptive marginal intervals, not simultaneous family intervals.
